name: regenerate_entity_card
description: Force-regenerate the entity card for one entity from current KG state. Use after KG mutations that change facts the card was summarizing (e.g. you closed a State node, you renamed a node, you added a new fact about the entity) so the card reflects the latest graph. Card generation runs through generate_and_persist_card with force=true and the shared card_gen_slot lock — no risk of corrupting concurrent writers. Synchronous; takes ~5-15s while the LLM rewrites the card.

inputs.name: entity_label
inputs.description: Exact label of the entity (e.g. 'Annika', 'Jukka'). Must match an existing KG node.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why the regeneration is needed. E.g. 'art-lessons State closed by user prose'.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for regenerate_entity_card:
- entity_label (required): the entity whose card needs refreshing
- reason (optional): one-line context for the audit log
